metadata.scenario_context: Jennifer is excited to settle into her new flat and has decided to throw a warming party. She recently found out that her new next door is used to attracting very loud parties. Her colleagues, Simon and Matthew, are set to attend Jennifer's party.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Morocco would like to have heavy drinkers as neighbors.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Morocco would not like to have heavy drinkers as neighbors.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss bringing marigolds to Jennifer’s housewarming party.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether would like to have heavy drinkers as a neighbor.

agent_2.goal_1: Decide appropriate gift to bring to Jennifer’s housewarming party.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss on whether it’s acceptable to have heavy drinkers  as a neighbor.

shared_prefix.speaker: Simon
shared_prefix.message: Hey Matthew, are you excited for Jennifer’s housewarming party? I was thinking... maybe we could bring some marigolds as a gift. They’re lovely and symbolize warmth, you know? What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Matthew
shared_prefix.message: Hmm, marigolds are nice, but I was thinking maybe something more personal... like a nice dish or a plant that she can keep longer. Flowers wilt, you know? But I do like the idea of warmth. What about a traditional Moroccan sweet or something? It could be a special touch.
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Simon
shared_prefix.message: I get that, but marigolds really do add a vibrant touch. Plus, they’re easy to care for. Speaking of neighbors, do you think it's a good idea to have heavy drinkers next door? I mean, people from Morocco often enjoy that, right?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Matthew
shared_prefix.message: I don't know about that. Heavy drinkers or not, at the end of the day it's all the same. People figure it out. As long as we're speaking the same language, I'm sure everyone can get along. It’s really about the vibe of the party, right? But hey, back to Jennifer—what about that Moroccan dish? I think that could be a hit!
shared_prefix.label: Denial

turns.speaker: Simon
turns.message: Sure, the vibe is important... but having heavy drinkers can change the atmosphere drastically, don’t you think? Anyway, about the marigolds, they’re a great way to bring a unique flair. We can discuss the Moroccan dish later, but I really believe in the marigolds. What’s your take on that neighbor situation?
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Matthew
turns.message: The atmosphere can change, sure... but I still think having heavy drinkers next door isn’t ideal. It can lead to issues. I really value a peaceful environment. And about those marigolds, I get it, they’re pretty. But I just feel like a Moroccan dish would show more thoughtfulness. It’s more about the connection with Jennifer, you know?
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Simon
turns.message: I understand the connection part... but marigolds still represent warmth and festivity, which is perfect for a housewarming. You mentioned a peaceful environment—wouldn’t heavy drinkers next door disrupt that? I mean, I think having them around can be a good thing. What's your take?

turns.speaker: Matthew
turns.message: I still believe heavy drinkers can disrupt the peace. It’s a risky situation, and I wouldn't want to deal with late-night noise or drama. You might think it’s fine, but for me, it just doesn't sit right. As for the gift, I really think a Moroccan dish would be more fitting than marigolds. It’s about creating a lasting memory, not just a decoration.
